mara_prod: Quick sync — we need to lock the safety ladder for the tenant-degrade path for next week's roll. Major customers asked for per-tenant exemptions and we need a clear, small-scope spec.
vinh_pm: Agreed. Propose 3 tiers: 1) hard kill switch, 2) graceful degrade to lightweight model variant, 3) admission control (queue + retry). Customers can opt into exemption list for tier 2 only. Thoughts?
sam_sre: +1 for the 3 tiers. Important: we need an automatic fallback if the lightweight model hits mem OOMs. Also define telemetry: per-tenant errors, reject rates, and percent-traffic-degraded.
li_devex: Can we keep the flag surface minimal? I suggest two flags: `tenant_degrade_enabled` (global) and `tenant_degrade_exempt:<tenant_id>` (per-tenant). We can wire the exemption list into the routing policy.
julia_sales: From customer side — enterprise pilots need a way to ask to be exempted temporarily without an SSO ticket. Can we support a short-lived exemption (24h) that product ops can enable?
mara_prod: That sounds reasonable. Proposal: ops UI to apply `exempt:tenant_id` with TTL; audit log required. For long-term, sales can request permanent exemption via contract.
sam_sre: Implementation notes: when degrade path triggers, emit `degrade_event{tenant, tier, reason}` and increment `degrade_active{tenant}` gauge. We'll need an alert on >1% of total traffic degraded or >5% for a single tenant.
vinh_pm: Launch criteria (must-haves): docs for flags, ops UI for TTL exemptions, SLOs defined, fallback chain implemented, and canary run for two regions. Nice-to-have: self-serve exemption request flow in console.
li_devex: Canary plan: roll to 5% traffic in us-west for 2h, collect fail rates and latency delta, then 10% eu-west 24h, then full. We should also run an A/B where 10% of traffic uses degradation tier2 vs direct reject to validate UX/metrics.
mara_prod: Good. Who owns rollout gating? I propose product owns criteria + runbook; SRE owns monitoring & kill-switch automation.
sam_sre: We'll own automated kill-switch based on the alerts. Need product to define exact thresholds. Also want a simulation run: replay last 24h to see how many tenants would have been degraded.
vinh_pm: Action items: @li_devex - wire flags + TTL UI prototype (ETA Wed). @sam_sre - replay job + alerting hooks (ETA Thu). @mara_prod - finalize thresholds and exemptions policy with legal (ETA Thu EOD). @julia_sales - collect top 5 pilot tenants to pre-register exemptions.
li_devex: I'll post a short PR snippet for the flag contract: ```
# flag contract
feature: tenant_safety_ladder_v1
flags:
  - tenant_degrade_enabled: boolean
  - tenant_degrade_exempt:<tenant_id>: boolean (TTL supported)
policies:
  - degrade_chain: [tier1_kill, tier2_light-model, tier3_queue]
```
deploy-bot: canary deployed to us-west-2 with 5% traffic at 2023-06-14T15:12:00Z :rocket:
julia_sales: added two pilot tenants (acme-inc, betaapps) to the pre-register list.
mara_prod: Thanks — we'll reconvene after the replay and first canary window. If replay shows >10 tenants impacted historically, we may need to add a throttle step.
vinh_pm: Noted. I'll draft the short rollout playbook and share in this thread. :thumbsup:
li_devex: quick question — for the A/B, do we want to collect user-facing quality metrics (e.g., corrected completions) or just infra metrics?
mara_prod: Both. Infra metrics to decide safety; quality metrics to decide whether tier2 preserves product value. Keep the eval hooks in the canary.
sam_sre: I'll add a dashboard tile for degraded-vs-control latency and token-accuracy proxy.
vinh_pm: OK team — moving to items. Thanks everyone.
